title: hive-word release: request body
description: The owner's disposition of an accepted answer on a question that holds work, not a decision item with no live work beneath it as it stands: the word hold is released and the work may proceed as the answer directs. word persists it through hive-pool release-question, as one handoff, passing on the envelope's expected_revisions. See spec/word.md.

note.description: The owner's disposition note: its own words on the card, never the Hive Mind's.

evidence.description: What the owner did on the answer, where it names a record.
